verdict.rationale: A national company registry could publish a machine-readable API spec such as OpenAPI, so this axis applies. The evidence pack does not show one. The only evidence is two probes that hit HTTP 403 at robots.txt on mca.gov.in and nsws.gov.in, so no spec, developer portal or API documentation was observed. Because nothing beyond robots.txt was fetched, absence here is unverified rather than proven, which keeps confidence at medium.
